create_MixUp_augmentation: create a MixUp instance with mixup_alpha and cutmix_alpha to apply data augmentation on a batch
run_mixup_on_batch: run the MixUp callable on a batch of images and targets to get mixed inputs and labels
build_cutmix_bbox: build random bounding box coordinates for cutmix using get_cutmix_bbox with an image shape and lambda
test_convert_to_one_hot: test convert_to_one_hot to transform class label indices into one-hot encoded tensors
review_mixup_target: review mixup_target to compute a weighted combination of two one-hot encoded target tensors
